subject: math
cluster: Experiment with transformations in the plane

items.prompt:
A translation moves every point:
A) The same distance in the same direction
B) Toward one point
C) Around a center
D) Across a line
items.answer: A) The same distance in the same direction

steps: A translation applies one displacement to all points.

items.prompt:
A rotation about $P$ keeps which point fixed?
A) Every point
B) The center $P$
C) No point
D) The image

steps: The center of rotation does not move.

items.prompt:
A reflection flips a figure over a:
A) Point
B) Line
C) Circle
D) Vector

steps: A reflection uses a mirror line.

items.prompt:
In a reflection over line $\ell$, $\ell$ is the ____ of the segment from a point to its image.
A) Midpoint
B) Perpendicular bisector
C) Endpoint
D) Parallel

steps: The mirror line perpendicularly bisects each such segment.

items.prompt:
Under a rotation about $P$, a point and its image are:
A) Different distances from $P$
B) The same distance from $P$
C) Always on line $\ell$
D) Fixed

steps: Both lie on a circle centered at $P$.

items.prompt:
Which rigid motion is defined by a center point and an angle?
A) Translation
B) Reflection
C) Rotation
D) Dilation

steps: A rotation needs a center and an angle.

items.prompt:
A point lies exactly on the mirror line of a reflection. Its image is:
A) On the opposite side
B) Itself
C) At the center
D) Undefined

steps: Points on the mirror line are their own images.

items.prompt:
Which fact must be true for a motion to be rigid?
A) It changes size
B) It preserves all distances between points
C) It only uses the origin
D) It removes points
items.answer: B) It preserves all distances between points
